name: client-support-ratings-notifications-preferences
executionConcern: owned support/rescue readback, rating eligibility/idempotency, notification registration/deep links and client preferences
objective: Close client support, ratings, notifications and preferences so every object/action is actor-owned, retry-safe, privacy-safe and refreshed from canonical DSH/Identity state rather than local delivery or UI state.
truthOwner: DSH owns support/rescue, ratings, notification/preference operational truth; Identity owns active actor/session/device binding; notification delivery is transport, not business truth.

tasks.objective: Close owner-scoped support conversations and governed rescue readback
tasks.currentProblem: Support screens exist, but current Product Truth still requires proof that ticket/message access is owner-scoped, internal notes are redacted, retries are single-effect and operator rescue cannot create local-only or financial truth.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace client support create/read/message flows through shared contracts to DSH support/incident/rescue persistence, and trace only exact partner/captain/control writers that affect the same ticket/order. Repair ownership, redaction, idempotency, expected-state/audit and canonical reload.
tasks.targetState: A client can create/read/message only owned support objects; internal notes never appear; duplicate/retry is single-effect; rescue outcomes arrive through canonical order/support readback and WLT remains financial owner.
tasks.action: Fix DSH support/rescue owner and database first, then bounded writer surfaces and app-client conversation/readback.
mustNotChange: Do not expose internal operator notes to client actors.
Do not allow guessed ticket/order IDs to cross actor scope.
Do not store a local-only rescue/support state as truth.
Do not mutate WLT balances/ledger from DSH rescue.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor ticket/conversation access is denied or hidden.
Internal notes are absent from client responses.
Rescue result reloads canonical order/support state without parallel finance truth.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused DSH owner change or roll forward while preserving audit evidence; never restore local support/rescue truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Support/rescue owner plus only directly affected cross-surface writers/readbacks.

tasks.objective: Close server-owned rating eligibility and single-effect submission
tasks.currentProblem: The client rating gate can render correctly while stale order state, wrong actor/order or duplicate submit creates an invalid or repeated rating; DSH ratings changed after the old package pin.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace rating eligibility and submit from App.tsx/client rating UI through DSH contracts, ratings owner and persistence; enforce owned completed-order eligibility, idempotency/version rules and canonical rating/reputation readback.
tasks.targetState: Only the authenticated eligible client can rate the allowed order/targets, and one logical submission creates one canonical rating effect across retry/restart.
tasks.action: Repair DSH ratings owner/database first, then client gate/submission and directly affected reputation/readback consumers.
mustNotChange: Do not authorize rating from client status text alone.
Do not rate another actor's or ineligible order.
Do not create multiple ratings from duplicate taps/retry.
Do not mark rating final before canonical DSH readback.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong actor/order and ineligible lifecycle states are rejected.
Repeated equivalent submission remains one effect.
Divergent reuse conflicts according to current contract.
Client reload after restart shows canonical submitted/eligible state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused DSH owner change or roll forward while preserving audit evidence; never restore local rating truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Ratings owner plus exact client/reputation bindings required by the same effect.

tasks.objective: Close push registration, notification object scope, deep-link reauthorization and preferences
tasks.currentProblem: Push/notification UI can report delivery or local mutation success without proving active-session token binding, actor ownership, stale deep-link authorization or committed preference/read-state reload.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace mobile push registration and notification/preference commands through Identity/session/device binding, DSH notification routes/contracts/persistence and client navigation. Repair token lifecycle on actor change, object scope, idempotency, canonical reload and deep-link reauthorization.
tasks.targetState: Push tokens follow the active actor/session/device lifecycle; notification/preferences are actor-owned; duplicate mutations are single-effect; every deep link re-authorizes current target state; offline/unavailable states remain explicit.
tasks.action: Fix Identity/device or DSH notification owner first according to the first divergence, then app-client center/preferences/navigation and runtime tests.
mustNotChange: Do not treat notification delivery as order/support truth.
Do not retain a previous actor's push binding after logout/session change.
Do not trust deep-link object IDs without server authorization.
Do not claim preference/read/delete success before committed reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Logout/actor switch invalidates or safely rebinds push registration.
Wrong-actor notification objects are denied or hidden.
Deep links re-authorize current target object/state.
Offline/service outage produces truthful retry/recovery state.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused notification/session change or roll forward at the canonical owner; never restore stale actor bindings or local notification truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Notification/session owner plus exact app-client preference/navigation/runtime bindings.
